reference_sql:
SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS n_products
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_name
alternatives: SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS n_products FROM products p RIGHT JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name
SELECT c.category_name, SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS n_products FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS n_products FROM products p RIGHT JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name
other_way.tradeoff: Swapping the sides with RIGHT JOIN keeps every category too, but most teams read LEFT JOIN faster.
